label: SYNTHETIC DEMO: Agung ash closes Bali while Sakurajima erupts, 14 Oct 2026 (invented data)
notes: Synthetic demo data, invented for TEPHRA's product demo by scripts/make_demo_case.py (seeded, no network); nothing in this case was recorded or happened. Real: the volcanoes, airports, FIRs, callsigns and their usual routes (data/volcanoes.json, data/airports.json, data/routes_apac.json, VRS standing data CC0). Invented: every SIGMET, VONA, JMA eruption report, Tokyo and Darwin VAA, METAR, TAF, wind profile and aircraft position, each stored under the URL the live poller requests so the same parsers read it. The HTML and XML pages say so in a comment; the JSON answers cannot. Story (UTC, 14 Oct 2026): Agung erupts at 0542Z; the observatory puts the ash higher than the SIGMET and moving south while the SIGMET says west and Darwin south-west; WADD's METARs and amended TAF report VA; Darwin's second VAA at 0718Z raises the top to FL380. Sakurajima's Tokyo VAA closes the event at 0630Z, JMA reports a new eruption at 0652Z and RJJJ a SIGMET while that VAA is in force. Semeru and Dukono carry routine SIGMETs and VAAs. Not in this case: satellite frames and raw Himawari data (TEPHRA credits frames to JMA or NICT; an invented picture would pass for theirs). Never scored by the backtest. Demo window 0705Z-0730Z (TEPHRA_REPLAY_START, TEPHRA_REPLAY_END).
